reports.title: ATEC Reports Third Quarter Financial Results

guidance.heading: Financial Outlook for the Full Year 2026
section: For fiscal year 2026, the Company now expects total revenue of approximately $862 million, including approximately $789 million of surgical revenue and approximately $73 million of EOS revenue. This outlook represents approximately 13% total revenue growth and approximately 15% surgical revenue growth for the year.

The Company now expects adjusted EBITDA of approximately $137 million, reflecting continued year-over-year profitability expansion. The Company also expects approximately $10 million of free cash flow for fiscal year 2026.
